correctness.rationale: Fix q≥2, m,n≥q+2, a=m−q,b=n−q≥2. For a chosen vertex set with i on shore A and j on B, a pair on A has n−j internally disjoint unblocked length-two paths and a pair on B has m−i, giving the exact face criterion (i≤1 or j≤b) AND (j≤1 or i≤a). The simplicial complex decomposes as P_A*P_B ∪ Δ_A*D_B ∪ D_A*Δ_B; the latter two joins are cones. Attaching subcomplexes L_A=P_A*D_B and L_B=D_A*P_B map nullhomotopically to the core because a,b≥2 make the simplex skeletons path connected, so each discrete shore inclusion is null. The two cofiber attachments split as K≈P_A*P_B∨ΣL_A∨ΣL_B. The uniform-matroid skeletons are binomial wedge sums, giving sphere families of degrees a+b−1,a+1,b+1 with multiplicities c_Ac_B,(n−1)c_A,(m−1)c_B. The disjoint face regions give the exact polynomial. This proves integral and infinite-parameter assertions; does not extrapolate from finite mod2 tests.
